text:
incident-bot: Pager: MODEL_DEGRADATION detected for model redwood-gen-2 in us-east1. Quality regression signal crossed threshold +15% over baseline. Routed to SRE oncall: alice. Severity: HIGH. Link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/2501112223

alice (oncall): Ack. I'm on it, pulling logs now.

bob (runtime-eng): I'm seeing increased token dropouts and repeated KV cache misses on 3/8 workers on canary pool. Correlates with deploy deploy-20260315-1145.

greg (deploy-bot): Deploy metadata: id=deploy-20260315-1145, author=chris, canary=10% -> spikes observed at 12:02-12:04 UTC.

chris (model-eng): I rolled a small canary earlier today. I didn't see this in smoke. Reproducing locally against the canary binary.

dana (sre): Quick customer-impact check: which customers hit redwood-gen-2 in the last 30m? @elaine can you fetch top-10 by qps and any customers with SLA alerts?

harper (oncall): If we can pin traffic back to redwood-gen-1 (previous stable) via routing override that should mitigate. Recommend emergency pin for default route.

greg (deploy-bot): Proposed emergency override command:

```
# pin routing to stable model
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/routing/overrides \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"default","model":"redwood-gen-1","duration":"2h","reason":"emergency rollback - quality regression"}'
```

alice (oncall): Executing override now.

incident-bot: Action initiated by alice: routing override submitted (req-7890). Propagation check started.

harper (oncall): Support / Account teams notified. @elaine please draft a customer-facing note for affected customers. Keep it short and action-oriented.

elaine (support): Customer draft: "Hi — we detected degraded output quality for requests served by redwood-gen-2 in us-east1. To protect request quality we've temporarily routed traffic to a stable model version (redwood-gen-1). No action required on your side. We'll follow up with a summary and any required remediation." Do we want to include ETA?

frank (product): ETA pls — how long to confirm mitigation and re-roll? Need short copy for status page.

bob (runtime-eng): Rollback propagation should be sub-5 minutes for the routing table. Full cross-region validation ~20–30 minutes to be confident.

dana (sre): Suggest status timeline for status.redwood.ai:
- 12:03 UTC — Detection & pager
- 12:06 UTC — Emergency routing override initiated
- 12:10 UTC — Majority of traffic routed to stable model (mitigation in progress)
- 12:30 UTC — Validation complete, begin post-incident analysis

chris (model-eng): Quick verification eval to run once pinned:
```
python tools/eval_quality.py --model redwood-gen-1 --samples 500 --checks coherence,consistency
```
Expected: quality metrics return to baseline +/- noise.

harper (oncall): I'm leaving a handoff note. Next oncall sam will take over at 12:35 UTC.

alice (oncall): Override accepted. Observability shows ~92% traffic to redwood-gen-1 within 3 minutes. Monitoring for errors and quality deltas. No escalations from customers so far.

incident-bot: Status update posted: "Degraded model quality — mitigation in progress (traffic routed to prior stable model)." Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2501112223

elaine (support): Sent customer-notify to affected list: "We've routed traffic to a stable model and are monitoring. Expect update in 30 minutes." (ticket cust-1234)

frank (product): Status page suggestion: "Investigating: We detected degraded output quality for model redwood-gen-2 affecting a subset of requests. Temporary routing to a prior stable model is in effect to protect request quality. No data loss. Next update in 30 minutes."

alice (oncall): Adding timeline and notes to the incident doc. Will start the postmortem template once validation green.

greg (deploy-bot): I'll schedule a cache backfill and sanity-check job once product/QA confirm green, and then coordinate a safe canary re-roll with reduced risk params.

sam (oncall-next): Acked. I'll monitor for 12:35 handoff and keep support looped. Any outstanding actions list them here.

incident-bot: Severity downgraded to MEDIUM; pager auto-silenced. Active mitigation closed at 12:32 UTC. Next scheduled update 12:50 UTC.

harper (oncall): Handoff complete. Leaving runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/model-regression.

alice (oncall): Final note: mitigation confirmed, customer-notify sent, starting timeline for postmortem and RCA.
